definitions.gloss: to soak in; to permeate; to seep into
definitions.explanation: for a liquid or substance to penetrate deeply into something

definitions.gloss: to sink in; to be deeply ingrained
definitions.explanation: for knowledge, habits, or feelings to become deeply established

examples.english: The rain soaked into the ground.
The sauce has soaked into the meat.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{染|し}み{込|こ}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This flavor has been ingrained in me since childhood.

examples.english: The manners my parents taught me are ingrained to my very core.

notes:
{染|し}み{込|こ}む is a compound verb combining ⟦{染|し}みる→染みる：10354_shimiru⟧ (to stain, permeate) + ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (into, deeply).

VERB TYPE:
- Godan verb (⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ conjugates as む-verb)
- Intransitive

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{染|し}み{込|こ}む (water soaks in)
- ⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{染|し}み{込|こ}む (flavor soaks in)
- ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{染|し}み{込|こ}む (to sink into one's body)
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{染|し}み{込|こ}む (to sink into one's heart)
- ⟦{骨|ほね}→骨：02166_hone⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{髄|ずい}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{染|し}み{込|こ}む (to seep into one's very bones)

SENSE 1 VS SENSE 2:
- Sense 1: Physical penetration of liquids/substances
- Sense 2: Abstract/metaphorical - deeply learned or ingrained

COOKING USAGE:
- Very common in cooking instructions when describing how flavors penetrate ingredients
- Often used with ⟦{出汁|だし}→出汁：04917_dashi⟧, ⟦たれ→タレ：10500_tare⟧, ⟦{煮汁|にじる}→煮汁：20628_nijiru⟧

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{浸透|しんとう}する→浸透する：22181_shintousuru⟧ (to permeate - more formal)
- ⟦{染|し}みる→染みる：10354_shimiru⟧ (to stain, seep - base verb)
- ⟦{吸|す}い{込|こ}む→吸い込む：06984_suikomu⟧ (to suck in, absorb)

REGISTER: Neutral. Common in everyday speech and cooking.
